source_standard.name: EU eForms
source_standard.compatibility_policy: Pin every parser to an explicit eForms SDK and notice subtype; reject unknown versions or preserve them as raw-only evidence until mapped.

search_api.response_representation: JSON search envelope containing requested fields and notice-format/language URLs
search_api.purpose: Discovery, bounded field projection, pagination or iteration checkpointing

canonical_notice.representation: XML eForms notice or legacy TED XML retrieved from an official TED URL
canonical_notice.purpose: Immutable raw evidence, notice-version lineage and deterministic field extraction
canonical_notice.rule: A Search API projection is not sufficient canonical evidence when the relevant claim depends on a field available only in the complete notice.

sdk_field_repository.purpose: Versioned mapping from eForms business terms and contexts to XML paths, field types and code lists
sdk_field_repository.rule: SDK metadata is parser configuration, not procurement evidence.

notice_blocks.label: Notice identification and metadata
notice_blocks.optionality: Dates, languages and identifiers vary by form, subtype and procedure lifecycle. Opening time is not assumed present.

notice_blocks.label: Buyer or contracting authority/entity
notice_blocks.optionality: Organisation identifiers and NUTS precision are source-dependent; natural-person contact fields are privacy-restricted metadata, not canonical opportunity claims.

notice_blocks.label: Procurement object
notice_blocks.optionality: A procedure may have one or many lots; descriptions are multilingual free text and must preserve original language separately from localised rendering.

notice_blocks.label: Economics, funding and award criteria
notice_blocks.optionality: Estimated value, VAT treatment, funding programme and criterion weights are not universally published; missing values remain UNKNOWN and must never be imputed as zero.

notice_blocks.label: Participation, procedure and document access
notice_blocks.optionality: National platform URLs are evidence links, not an authorisation to crawl linked documents; document ingestion requires separate source and rights admission.

notice_blocks.label: Results, awards and competition statistics
notice_blocks.optionality: Award information occurs only in relevant result notices and may be incomplete. TED Open Data documents known gaps in winner information and some relationships.

canonical_observed_claims: notice publication, modification, correction or cancellation
buyer organisation and officially published identifiers
place of performance and NUTS codes
stated estimated or awarded value and currency
published winner organisation and award result
proposal_only_claims: semantic fit between a supplier and a tender
inferred procurement theme not established by CPV or explicit text
prohibited_claims: canonical opportunity claim derived from natural-person contact data

default_actions: exclude from public API and exports
retain only when source-specific purpose and legal basis are recorded

first_query_contract.natural_language_example: Show newly published cybersecurity procurements above EUR 500000 in Spain, France and Germany with more than 15 days remaining; explain recurring buyers, changed or cancelled notices and the official evidence.
deterministic_filters: published monetary value and currency-normalised threshold
submission deadline relative to a declared clock
first_query_contract.unknown_handling: A notice missing value, deadline, NUTS or award fields is excluded only from the corresponding filter result and remains visible as uncovered or incomplete where relevant.

quality_dimensions: required-field completeness by country and subtype
kill_switches: quarantine a publication period or country
disable public rendering and export independently
